description_en: Updates the configuration of a specified custom agent in a workspace and executes the update asynchronously. Omitted top-level fields retain their original configurations. You can call the GetCustomAgent operation to query the update result
description_zh: 更新指定工作空间中的自定义智能体配置，并异步执行更新。省略的顶层字段保留原配置，可通过 GetCustomAgent 查询更新结果
name: UpdateCustomAgent

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom agent belongs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义智能体所属的工作空间 ID
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the custom agent. You can obtain this ID from the response of the CreateCustomAgent or ListCustomAgents operation
parameters.help_zh: 自定义智能体的唯一标识，可从 CreateCustomAgent 或 ListCustomAgents 的响应中获取
parameters.name: agent_id

fields.help_en: The subdirectory under /mnt/agenticfs/ in the container. This field is required for each mount item. Mount targets must not be duplicated or form parent-child overrides
fields.help_zh: 容器内 /mnt/agenticfs/ 下的子目录，每个挂载项必填。挂载目标不得重复或形成父子覆盖
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: The existing non-empty relative directory under the access point. This field is required for each mount item. Root directories, absolute paths, and parent directory traversals are not allowed
fields.help_zh: AccessPoint 下已存在的非空相对目录，每个挂载项必填。不允许根目录、绝对路径或上级目录跳转
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and false indicates read and write. If omitted, the default value is false
fields.help_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写；省略时默认为 false
fields.name: read_only

fields.help_en: The domain name of the access point. This field is required for each mount item. Use the DomainName value from the NAS ListAccessPoints response. Do not include the protocol, port, or path
fields.help_zh: AccessPoint 域名，每个挂载项必填。取 NAS ListAccessPoints 响应中的 DomainName，不含协议、端口或路径
fields.name: server

fields.help_en: The list of additional AgenticFS mounts. The total number of AgenticFS and OSS mounts cannot exceed 10. During creation, omitting this field or passing an empty array [] indicates no additional mounts. During an update, omitting this field retains the original value, and passing an empty array [] clears the list. You cannot pass null
fields.help_zh: AgenticFS 额外挂载列表，与 ossMounts 合计最多 10 项。创建时省略或传 [] 表示无额外挂载；更新时省略保留原值，传 [] 清空。不能传 null
fields.name: agentic_fs_mounts

fields.help_en: The startup entry point for the code package. Code package deployment is currently not supported. Omit this field
fields.help_zh: 代码包启动入口。当前暂不支持代码包部署，请省略
fields.name: entrypoint

fields.help_en: The language runtime identifier for the code package. Code package deployment is currently not supported. Omit this field
fields.help_zh: 代码包的语言运行时标识。当前暂不支持代码包部署，请省略
fields.name: language_runtime

fields.help_en: The source URI of the code package. Code package deployment is currently not supported. Omit this field
fields.help_zh: 代码包来源 URI。当前暂不支持代码包部署，请省略
fields.name: source_uri

fields.help_en: The code package deployment configuration. This is currently not supported. Omit this field and use artifact.container instead
fields.help_zh: 代码包部署配置，当前暂不支持，请省略并使用 artifact.container
fields.name: code

fields.help_en: The optional executable program and startup parameters. If specified, this must be a non-empty string. When updating the artifact, omitting this field uses the default startup method of the image. To retain the original custom startup command, provide this field together
fields.help_zh: 可选的可执行程序及启动参数，指定时必须为非空字符串。更新 artifact 时，省略该字段使用镜像默认启动方式；需要保留原自定义启动命令时请一并提供
fields.name: entrypoint

fields.help_en: The ID of the ACR instance to which the image repository belongs. This field cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: 镜像仓库所属的 ACR 实例 ID，不能为空
fields.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The namespace to which the ACR image repository belongs. This field cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: ACR 镜像仓库所属的命名空间，不能为空
fields.name: namespace

fields.help_en: The name of the image repository in the ACR namespace. This field cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: ACR 命名空间中的镜像仓库名称，不能为空
fields.name: repo

fields.help_en: The image tag used for deployment. This field cannot be empty. When updating the tag, you must also provide artifact.port and other required image fields
fields.help_zh: 部署使用的镜像标签，不能为空。更新标签时，须同时提供 artifact.port 和其他必需的镜像字段
fields.name: tag

fields.help_en: The image source type. Currently, only acr is supported, which indicates Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR)
fields.help_zh: 镜像来源类型。当前仅支持 acr，表示阿里云容器镜像服务 ACR
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The ACR container image configuration. You must specify the type, instanceId, namespace, repo, and tag fields. Do not configure the code field at the same time
fields.help_zh: ACR 容器镜像配置，须提供 type、instanceId、namespace、repo 和 tag。请勿同时配置 code
fields.name: container

fields.help_en: The TCP port listened to by the agent service. Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh: 智能体服务监听的 TCP 端口，取值为 1～65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The deployment artifact configuration. Currently, only ACR container images are supported. Specify the container field and the service listening port field, and omit the code field. During an update, you must specify the port field and all required fields of the container object
fields.help_zh: 部署制品配置。当前仅支持 ACR 容器镜像，请填写 container 和服务监听端口 port，省略 code。更新时须提供 port 和 container 的全部必需字段
fields.name: artifact

fields.example: 提供对话服务的自定义智能体
fields.help_en: The description of the agent's purpose. The maximum length is 1,024 characters after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed. If omitted, the original value is retained. Pass null to clear the description
fields.help_zh: 智能体的用途说明，去除首尾空白后最多 1024 个字符。省略保留原值，传 null 清除描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The name of the environment variable. This field cannot be empty and must be unique within the current environment variable list
fields.help_zh: 环境变量名称，不能为空，且在本次环境变量列表中不得重复
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value of the environment variable. This must be a string. Empty strings are allowed
fields.help_zh: 环境变量值，必须为字符串，允许空字符串
fields.name: value

fields.help_en: The list of environment variables. Each item includes a name and a value. This list is replaced in its entirety during an update
fields.help_zh: 环境变量列表，每项包含名称和值。更新时整体替换该列表
fields.name: variables

fields.help_en: The environment variable configuration for the agent process. Omitting this top-level field retains the original value. Providing this object but omitting the variables field clears the custom environment variables. To retain the variables, provide the complete list
fields.help_zh: 智能体进程的环境变量配置。省略该顶层字段保留原值；提供该对象但省略 variables 会清空自定义环境变量，保留变量时请一并提供完整列表
fields.name: environment

fields.help_en: This parameter currently does not take effect. Omit this field
fields.help_zh: 此参数当前不生效，请省略
fields.name: healthy_threshold

fields.help_en: The interval between two health checks, in seconds. This must be a positive integer. If omitted, the default value is 10
fields.help_zh: 两次健康检查的间隔，单位为秒，必须为正整数，省略时默认为 10
fields.name: interval_seconds

fields.help_en: The HTTP health check path. This must start with a forward slash (/). If omitted, the default value is /healthz
fields.help_zh: HTTP 健康检查路径，必须以 / 开头，省略时默认为 /healthz
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: The port accessed for health checks. This field is required when configuring a health check. Valid values: 1 to 65535
fields.help_zh: 健康检查访问的端口，配置健康检查时必须填写，取值为 1～65535
fields.name: port

fields.help_en: The timeout period for a single health check, in seconds. This must be a positive integer and less than intervalSeconds. If omitted, the default value is 2
fields.help_zh: 单次健康检查的超时秒数，必须为正整数且小于 intervalSeconds，省略时默认为 2
fields.name: timeout_seconds

fields.help_en: The number of consecutive health check failures required to mark the agent as unhealthy. This must be a positive integer. If omitted, the default value is 3
fields.help_zh: 连续健康检查失败达到该次数后判定不健康，必须为正整数，省略时默认为 3
fields.name: unhealthy_threshold

fields.help_en: The optional HTTP health check configuration. When providing this object, you must specify the port field. Other unspecified items use default values. Omitting this field during creation indicates no configuration. During an update, omitting this top-level field retains the original configuration, and passing null removes the health check
fields.help_zh: 可选的 HTTP 健康检查配置。提供该对象时必须填写 port，未指定的其他项使用默认值。创建时省略表示不配置；更新时省略该顶层字段保留原配置，传 null 移除健康检查
fields.name: health_check

fields.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service logstore that receives agent logs
fields.help_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Logstore 名称
fields.name: logstore

fields.help_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project that receives agent logs
fields.help_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Project 名称
fields.name: project

fields.help_en: The Simple Log Service log delivery destination. When updating this object, you must provide both the project and logstore fields, and they cannot be empty
fields.help_zh: SLS 日志投递目标。更新该对象时，project 和 logstore 须同时提供且不能为空
fields.name: sls

fields.help_en: The log delivery configuration for the agent. You can specify the Simple Log Service project and logstore. After a successful creation or update, verify that logs are delivered properly
fields.help_zh: 智能体日志投递配置，可指定日志服务 SLS 的 Project 和 Logstore。创建或更新成功后，请确认日志是否正常投递
fields.name: logging

fields.help_en: The name of the custom agent. The length must be 1 to 128 characters after leading and trailing whitespaces are removed. The name must be unique within the same workspace. If omitted, the original value is retained. You cannot pass null or a blank name
fields.help_zh: 自定义智能体名称，去除首尾空白后长度为 1～128 个字符，同一工作空间内不可重名。省略保留原值，不能传 null 或空白名称
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the agent to access the Internet. A Boolean value is required when configuring accessInternet. For this to take effect, the workspace must also allow Internet access
fields.help_zh: 是否允许智能体访问互联网。配置 accessInternet 时必须提供布尔值；实际生效还需工作空间允许互联网访问
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The Internet access configuration. If this access item is omitted, Internet access is not restricted on the agent side. However, the workspace must still allow Internet access
fields.help_zh: 互联网访问配置。省略该访问项时，智能体侧不限制互联网访问；仍需工作空间允许互联网访问
fields.name: access_internet

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to allow the agent to access the user VPC configured for the workspace. A Boolean value is required when configuring accessVpc. For this to take effect, the workspace must also allow VPC access
fields.help_zh: 是否允许智能体访问工作空间配置的用户 VPC。配置 accessVpc 时必须提供布尔值；实际生效还需工作空间允许 VPC 访问
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The user VPC access configuration. If this access item is omitted, VPC access is not restricted on the agent side. However, the workspace must still be configured to allow access to the user VPC
fields.help_zh: 用户 VPC 访问配置。省略该访问项时，智能体侧不限制 VPC 访问；仍需工作空间配置并允许访问用户 VPC
fields.name: access_vpc

fields.help_en: The network access configuration for the agent. When providing this object, omitted access items are treated as allowed. The actual accessible scope is still subject to the workspace network configuration. To retain the original restrictions during an update, specify both accessInternet and accessVpc
fields.help_zh: 智能体的网络访问配置。提供该对象时，省略的访问项按允许处理；实际可访问范围仍受工作空间网络配置限制。更新时若需保留原限制，请同时填写 accessInternet 和 accessVpc
fields.name: network

fields.help_en: The name of the OSS bucket. This field is required for each mount item. The name must be 3 to 63 characters in length and can contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens. It cannot start or end with a hyphen
fields.help_zh: OSS Bucket 名称，每个挂载项必填。长度为 3～63 个字符，仅包含小写字母、数字和短横线，不能以短横线开头或结尾
fields.name: bucket_name

fields.help_en: The subdirectory under /mnt/oss/ in the container. This field is required for each mount item. Mount targets must not be duplicated or form parent-child overrides
fields.help_zh: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录，每个挂载项必填。挂载目标不得重复或形成父子覆盖
fields.name: mount_path

fields.help_en: The non-empty object directory prefix in the bucket, such as datasets/train. Leading and trailing forward slashes (/) are removed. Root directories are not supported. Do not use parent directory traversals
fields.help_zh: Bucket 内非空的对象目录前缀，例如 datasets/train。首尾的 / 会被去除；不支持根目录，请勿使用上级目录跳转
fields.name: path

fields.help_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and false indicates read and write. If omitted, the default value is false
fields.help_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写；省略时默认为 false
fields.name: read_only

fields.help_en: The list of OSS mounts. The total number of OSS and AgenticFS mounts cannot exceed 10. For each item, you must specify the bucketName, path, and mountPath fields. Mount targets must not be duplicated or overlap with each other. This list is replaced in its entirety during an update. Pass an empty array [] to clear the list
fields.help_zh: OSS 挂载列表，与 agenticFsMounts 合计最多 10 项。每项须填写 bucketName、path 和 mountPath；挂载目标不得重复或相互覆盖。更新时整体替换该列表，传 [] 清空
fields.name: oss_mounts

fields.help_en: The request header configuration for the current protocol. The key is a non-empty request header name, and the value must be a string
fields.help_zh: 当前协议的请求头配置。键为非空的请求头名称，值必须为字符串
fields.name: headers

fields.help_en: The description of the current API path
fields.help_zh: 当前接口路径的用途说明
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The non-empty API path corresponding to the current protocol
fields.help_zh: 当前协议对应的非空接口路径
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The list of API paths corresponding to the current protocol
fields.help_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径列表
fields.name: paths

fields.help_en:
The invocation protocol type. Valid values:
agui: AG-UI protocol.
openai-chat-completion: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible protocol.
custom: Custom protocol
fields.help_zh: 调用协议类型。agui：AG-UI 协议；openai-chat-completion：OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；custom：自定义协议
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The list of invocation protocols supported by the agent. Each item includes the protocol type, along with optional paths and request headers. The entire list is replaced during an update
fields.help_zh: 智能体支持的调用协议列表，每项包含协议类型以及可选的路径和请求头。更新时整体替换该列表
fields.name: protocol

fields.help_en: The ARN of the RAM role used by the agent to access user cloud resources. The role must have permissions to access the cloud resources
fields.help_zh: 智能体访问用户云资源时使用的 RAM 角色 ARN。角色需具备所访问云资源的权限
fields.name: role_arn

fields.help_en:
The compute specification. Valid values:
INTERACTIVE: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory.
STANDARD: 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory.
HEAVY: 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB of memory
fields.help_zh: 计算规格。INTERACTIVE：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存；STANDARD：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存；HEAVY：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存
fields.name: compute_class

fields.help_en: The compute resource configuration for the agent runtime instance
fields.help_zh: 智能体运行实例的计算资源配置
fields.name: compute

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable elastic scaling. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled.
When runtime is provided, omitting this field defaults to false
fields.help_zh: 是否启用弹性扩缩容。true 表示开启，false 表示关闭。提供 runtime 时，省略本字段默认为 false
fields.name: enabled

fields.help_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions for a single runtime instance. Valid values: 1 to 100. When runtime is provided, omitting this field uses the default value of 100
fields.help_zh: 单个运行实例的最大并发会话数，取值为 1～100。提供 runtime 时，省略本字段使用默认值 100
fields.name: max_concurrent_sessions_per_sandbox

fields.help_en: The maximum number of runtime instances. Valid values: 1 to 100. The value cannot be less than minSandboxCount. When runtime is provided, omitting this field uses the default value of 10
fields.help_zh: 最大运行实例数，取值为 1～100，且不能小于 minSandboxCount。提供 runtime 时，省略本字段使用默认值 10
fields.name: max_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: The minimum number of runtime instances. Valid values: 1 to 100. The value cannot be greater than maxSandboxCount. When runtime is provided, omitting this field uses the default value of 1
fields.help_zh: 最小运行实例数，取值为 1～100，且不能大于 maxSandboxCount。提供 runtime 时，省略本字段使用默认值 1
fields.name: min_sandbox_count

fields.help_en: The session idle timeout in seconds. Valid values: 60 to 86400. When runtime is provided, omitting this field uses the default value of 600
fields.help_zh: 会话空闲上限，单位为秒，取值为 60～86400。提供 runtime 时，省略本字段使用默认值 600
fields.name: session_ttl_seconds

fields.help_en: The optional elastic policy. When runtime is provided, omitting hpa or its fields uses the default values: enabled is false, the minimum number of instances is 1, the maximum number of instances is 10, the maximum number of concurrent sessions per instance is 100, and the session idle timeout is 600 seconds. To retain the original policy during an update, provide the complete hpa configuration
fields.help_zh: 可选的弹性策略。提供 runtime 时，省略 hpa 或其字段使用默认值：enabled 为 false，最小实例数为 1、最大实例数为 10、单实例最大并发会话数为 100、会话空闲上限为 600 秒。更新时若需保留原策略，请一并提供完整的 hpa 配置
fields.name: hpa

fields.help_en: The name of the HTTP request header used by the session policy. This parameter is required when type is ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD and must be a valid HTTP request header name. Omit this parameter for other policies
fields.help_zh: 会话策略使用的 HTTP 请求头名称。type 为 ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD 时必填，须为合法的 HTTP 请求头名称；其他策略请省略
fields.name: header_name

fields.help_en:
The session policy type. Valid values:
AFFINITY: Session affinity.
ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD: Associates sessions by using the request header specified by headerName.
ISOLATED_COOKIE: Not recommended.
DISABLED: A compatibility option. The response returns AFFINITY
fields.help_zh: 会话策略类型。AFFINITY：会话亲和；ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD：使用 headerName 指定请求头关联会话。ISOLATED_COOKIE 暂不建议使用。DISABLED 为兼容选项，响应返回 AFFINITY
fields.name: type

fields.help_en: The session policy configuration, which is used to set the session association method for requests
fields.help_zh: 会话策略配置，用于设置请求的会话关联方式
fields.name: session_policy

fields.help_en: The runtime configuration. When this object is provided, both compute and sessionPolicy must be present. To retain the original elastic policy, provide the complete hpa configuration. Omitting the top-level runtime field retains the original configuration
fields.help_zh: 运行配置。提供该对象时，compute 和 sessionPolicy 必须同时存在；若需保留原弹性策略，请一并提供完整的 hpa 配置。省略 runtime 顶层字段保留原配置
fields.name: runtime

parameters.help_en: The update configuration for the custom agent. Provide at least one top-level field. Omitted top-level fields retain their original values. When providing a configuration object, specify its required subfields and include any optional configurations that you want to retain. Arrays are replaced in their entirety
parameters.help_zh: 自定义智能体更新配置，至少提供一个顶层字段。省略的顶层字段保留原值；提供配置对象时须填写其必需子字段，并一并提供需要保留的可选配置。数组整体替换
parameters.name: body

parameters.help_en: Idempotency is not currently guaranteed. Do not rely on this parameter to prevent duplicate requests
parameters.help_zh: 当前不提供幂等保证，请勿依赖该参数防止重复请求
parameters.name: client_token

code.description_en: The request result code. The value is SUCCESS when the request is successful
code.description_zh: 请求结果码。成功时为 SUCCESS

data.description_en: The latest submitted configuration and status of the custom agent. A successful response indicates that the request is accepted, but the configuration may not have taken effect yet
data.description_zh: 自定义智能体的最新提交配置及状态。响应成功表示请求已受理，配置可能尚未生效

agentId.description_en: The unique identifier of the custom agent. You can obtain this ID from the response of the CreateCustomAgent or ListCustomAgents operation
agentId.description_zh: 自定义智能体的唯一标识，可从 CreateCustomAgent 或 ListCustomAgents 的响应中获取

agenticFsMounts.description_en: The latest submitted list of additional AgenticFS mounts
agenticFsMounts.description_zh: 最新提交的 AgenticFS 额外挂载列表

items.description_en: An AgenticFS access point directory mount configuration item
items.description_zh: 一个 AgenticFS AccessPoint 目录挂载配置项

mountPath.description_en: The AgenticFS mount directory in the container, located under /mnt/agenticfs/
mountPath.description_zh: 容器内的 AgenticFS 挂载目录，位于 /mnt/agenticfs/ 下
mountPath.title_en: 容器内 /mnt/agenticfs/ 下的子目录，每个挂载项由后端校验必填；挂载目标不得重复或父子覆盖
mountPath.title_zh: 容器内 /mnt/agenticfs/ 下的子目录，每个挂载项由后端校验必填；挂载目标不得重复或父子覆盖

path.description_en: The relative directory within the mounted AccessPoint
path.description_zh: 挂载的 AccessPoint 内相对目录
path.title_en: AccessPoint 下已存在的非空相对目录，每个挂载项由后端校验必填；不允许根目录、绝对路径或上级目录段
path.title_zh: AccessPoint 下已存在的非空相对目录，每个挂载项由后端校验必填；不允许根目录、绝对路径或上级目录段

readOnly.description_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and a value of false indicates read and write
readOnly.description_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写
readOnly.title_en: 是否只读挂载，省略默认 false；不是 RAM 角色只读策略
readOnly.title_zh: 是否只读挂载，省略默认 false；不是 RAM 角色只读策略

server.description_en: The domain name of the AgenticFS AccessPoint used for the mount
server.description_zh: 挂载使用的 AgenticFS AccessPoint 域名
server.title_en: AccessPoint 域名，每个挂载项由后端校验必填；不含协议、端口或路径，取 NAS ListAccessPoints 响应的 DomainName
server.title_zh: AccessPoint 域名，每个挂载项由后端校验必填；不含协议、端口或路径，取 NAS ListAccessPoints 响应的 DomainName

agenticFsMounts.title_en: AgenticFS 额外挂载列表，与 ossMounts 合计最多 10 项
agenticFsMounts.title_zh: AgenticFS 额外挂载列表，与 ossMounts 合计最多 10 项

artifact.description_en: The latest submitted deployment artifact configuration, including the service listening port and ACR container image. Check latestVersionStatus to determine whether the configuration has taken effect
artifact.description_zh: 最新提交的部署制品配置，包含服务监听端口和 ACR 容器镜像。是否已生效请结合 latestVersionStatus 判断

code.description_en: The code package configuration field. Code package deployment is not supported
code.description_zh: 代码包配置字段。当前暂不支持代码包部署

entrypoint.description_en: The startup entry point of the code package. Code package deployment is not supported
entrypoint.description_zh: 代码包启动入口。当前暂不支持代码包部署

languageRuntime.description_en: The language runtime identifier of the code package. Code package deployment is not supported
languageRuntime.description_zh: 代码包的语言运行时标识。当前暂不支持代码包部署

sourceUri.description_en: The source URI of the code package. Code package deployment is not supported
sourceUri.description_zh: 代码包来源 URI。当前暂不支持代码包部署

container.description_en: The latest submitted ACR container image configuration
container.description_zh: 最新提交的 ACR 容器镜像配置

entrypoint.description_en: The custom executable program and startup parameters. If not configured, the default startup method of the image is used
entrypoint.description_zh: 自定义的可执行程序及启动参数。未配置时使用镜像默认启动方式

instanceId.description_en: The ID of the ACR instance to which the image repository belongs
instanceId.description_zh: 镜像仓库所属的 ACR 实例 ID

namespace.description_en: The namespace to which the ACR image repository belongs
namespace.description_zh: ACR 镜像仓库所属的命名空间

repo.description_en: The name of the image repository in the ACR namespace
repo.description_zh: ACR 命名空间中的镜像仓库名称

type.description_en: The image source type. A value of acr indicates Alibaba Cloud Container Registry (ACR)
type.description_zh: 镜像来源类型，acr 表示阿里云容器镜像服务 ACR

port.description_en: The TCP port listened on by the agent service
port.description_zh: 智能体服务监听的 TCP 端口

createMode.description_en: The creation method of the agent. The value is CUSTOM for custom agents
createMode.description_zh: 智能体创建方式。自定义智能体返回 CUSTOM

createdAt.description_en: The creation time of the agent. The time is in ISO 8601 format. The trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone. Fractional seconds may be included
createdAt.description_zh: 智能体创建时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

deployType.description_en: The deployment method of the agent. Custom agents are deployed and managed by the platform, and the value is MANAGED
deployType.description_zh: 智能体部署方式。自定义智能体由平台部署和管理，返回 MANAGED

description.description_en: The description of the agent's purpose
description.example: 提供对话服务的自定义智能体

environment.description_en: The environment variable configuration for the agent process
environment.description_zh: 智能体进程的环境变量配置

variables.description_en: The latest submitted list of environment variables
variables.description_zh: 最新提交的环境变量列表

name.description_en: The name of the environment variable

value.description_en: The string value of the environment variable. Empty strings are allowed
value.description_zh: 环境变量的字符串值，允许空字符串

healthCheck.description_en: The HTTP health check configuration of the agent. This field is empty if no configuration is specified
healthCheck.description_zh: 智能体的 HTTP 健康检查配置。未配置时为空

healthyThreshold.description_en: This parameter does not take effect

intervalSeconds.description_en: The interval between two consecutive health checks, in seconds
intervalSeconds.description_zh: 两次健康检查的间隔，单位为秒

port.description_en: The port accessed for the HTTP health check
port.description_zh: HTTP 健康检查访问的端口

timeoutSeconds.description_en: The timeout period for a single health check, in seconds
timeoutSeconds.description_zh: 单次健康检查的超时时间，单位为秒

unhealthyThreshold.description_en: The number of consecutive health check failures required to mark the agent as unhealthy
unhealthyThreshold.description_zh: 连续健康检查失败达到该次数后判定不健康

latestExecutionError.description_en: The waiting or execution error of the latest configuration version. This field is returned only when the version is waiting for a retry or fails to execute
latestExecutionError.description_zh: 最新配置版本的等待或执行错误，仅在该版本等待重试或执行失败时返回

code.description_en: The reason code for the waiting or execution failure of the latest configuration. This code is used to determine the subsequent processing method
code.description_zh: 最新配置的等待或执行失败原因码，用于判断后续处理方式
code.title_en: 稳定原因码；等待 ACR 配置为 ACRDependencyNotReady，具体失败保留可公开的稳定原因码
code.title_zh: 稳定原因码；等待 ACR 配置为 ACRDependencyNotReady，具体失败保留可公开的稳定原因码

message.description_en: The description of the reason why the latest configuration is waiting or failed to execute. Refer to code and retryable to determine what to do next
message.description_zh: 最新配置等待或执行失败的原因说明。请结合 code 和 retryable 判断后续操作
message.example: Agent 执行失败，请检查配置后重新提交。
message.title_en: 用户可读的等待或失败说明
message.title_zh: 用户可读的等待或失败说明

retryable.description_en: Specifies whether automatic retry is performed. If the value is true, you can query again later. If the value is false, check and fix the configuration based on the reason, and then resubmit
retryable.description_zh: 是否会自动重试。true 时可稍后再次查询；false 时请根据原因检查并修复配置后重新提交
retryable.title_en: 是否正在由后端自动重试；false 时根据原因修复后重新提交 Agent
retryable.title_zh: 是否正在由后端自动重试；false 时根据原因修复后重新提交 Agent

latestExecutionError.title_en: 最新期望版本执行错误
latestExecutionError.title_zh: 最新期望版本执行错误

latestSpecVersion.description_en: The current latest configuration version number. Updates with the same configuration may retain the original version number. This field does not indicate that the configuration has taken effect
latestSpecVersion.description_zh: 当前最新配置版本号。相同配置的更新可能保留原版本号；本字段不代表该配置已经生效

latestVersionStatus.description_en:
The execution status corresponding to latestSpecVersion. Valid values:
pending: Waiting for execution.
processing: Executing.
waiting_retry: Waiting for retry.
succeeded: Execution succeeded.
failed: Execution failed.
superseded: Superseded by a subsequent version
latestVersionStatus.description_zh: latestSpecVersion 对应的执行状态。pending：等待执行；processing：执行中；waiting_retry：等待重试；succeeded：执行成功；failed：执行失败；superseded：已被后续版本替代

logging.description_en: The latest submitted log delivery configuration
logging.description_zh: 最新提交的日志投递配置

sls.description_en: The Simple Log Service (SLS) log delivery destination

logstore.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service logstore that receives agent logs
logstore.description_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Logstore 名称

project.description_en: The name of the Simple Log Service project that receives agent logs
project.description_zh: 接收智能体日志的 SLS Project 名称

name.description_en: The name of the custom agent

network.description_en: The network access configuration of the agent. The actual access scope is also restricted by the workspace network configuration
network.description_zh: 智能体的网络访问配置，实际访问范围还受工作空间网络配置限制

accessInternet.description_en: The Internet access configuration of the agent. If this field is not configured, Internet access is allowed on the agent side, but it is still restricted by the workspace
accessInternet.description_zh: 智能体的互联网访问配置。未配置该项时，智能体侧允许访问，仍受工作空间限制

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether Internet access is allowed on the agent side. The actual access is still restricted by the workspace
enabled.description_zh: 智能体侧是否允许访问互联网，实际访问仍受工作空间限制

accessVpc.description_en: The user VPC access configuration of the agent. If this field is not configured, user VPC access is allowed on the agent side, but it is still restricted by the workspace
accessVpc.description_zh: 智能体的用户 VPC 访问配置。未配置该项时，智能体侧允许访问，仍受工作空间限制

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether access to the user VPC configured for the workspace is allowed on the agent side. The actual access is still restricted by the workspace
enabled.description_zh: 智能体侧是否允许访问工作空间配置的用户 VPC，实际访问仍受工作空间限制

ossMounts.description_en: The latest submitted list of OSS directory mounts
ossMounts.description_zh: 最新提交的 OSS 目录挂载列表

items.description_en: An OSS directory mount configuration item
items.description_zh: 一个 OSS 目录挂载配置项

bucketName.description_en: The name of the mounted OSS bucket
bucketName.description_zh: 挂载的 OSS Bucket 名称
bucketName.title_en: OSS Bucket 名称；每个挂载项必填
bucketName.title_zh: OSS Bucket 名称；每个挂载项必填

mountPath.description_en: The OSS mount directory in the container, located under /mnt/oss/
mountPath.description_zh: 容器内的 OSS 挂载目录，位于 /mnt/oss/ 下
mountPath.title_en: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录；每个挂载项必填
mountPath.title_zh: 容器内 /mnt/oss/ 下的子目录；每个挂载项必填

path.description_en: The object directory prefix in the mounted bucket
path.description_zh: 挂载的 Bucket 内对象目录前缀
path.title_en: Bucket 内非空对象前缀，例如 datasets/train；不允许根目录或上级目录跳转
path.title_zh: Bucket 内非空对象前缀，例如 datasets/train；不允许根目录或上级目录跳转

readOnly.description_en: Specifies whether the mount is read-only. A value of true indicates read-only, and a value of false indicates read and write
readOnly.description_zh: 是否只读挂载。true 表示只读，false 表示可读写

ossMounts.title_en: OSS 挂载列表，与 AgenticFS 合计最多 10 项
ossMounts.title_zh: OSS 挂载列表，与 AgenticFS 合计最多 10 项

protocol.description_en: The list of invocation protocol configurations for the agent
protocol.description_zh: 智能体的调用协议配置列表

items.description_en: An invocation protocol and its path and request header configurations
items.description_zh: 一种调用协议及其路径、请求头配置

additionalProperties.description_en: The string value of the protocol request header
additionalProperties.description_zh: 协议请求头的字符串值

headers.description_en: The request header configurations for the current protocol, where the key is the name and the value is a string
headers.description_zh: 当前协议的请求头配置，键为名称，值为字符串

paths.description_en: The list of API paths corresponding to the current protocol
paths.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径列表

items.description_en: An API path and its description
items.description_zh: 一个接口路径及其用途说明

description.description_en: The description of the current API path
description.description_zh: 当前接口路径的用途说明

name.description_en: The API path corresponding to the current protocol
name.description_zh: 当前协议对应的接口路径

type.description_en:
The invocation protocol type. Valid values:
agui: AG-UI protocol.
openai-chat-completion: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible protocol.
custom: Custom protocol
type.description_zh: 调用协议类型。agui：AG-UI 协议；openai-chat-completion：OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容协议；custom：自定义协议

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the workspace to which the agent belongs
regionId.description_zh: 智能体所属工作空间的地域 ID

roleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role used by the agent to access user cloud resources
roleArn.description_zh: 智能体访问用户云资源时使用的 RAM 角色 ARN

runtime.description_en: The latest committed runtime configurations, including compute specifications, session policy, and elastic policy
runtime.description_zh: 最新提交的运行配置，包括计算规格、会话策略和弹性策略

compute.description_en: The compute resource configuration for the agent runtime instance
compute.description_zh: 智能体运行实例的计算资源配置

computeClass.description_en:
The compute specification. Valid values:
INTERACTIVE: 1 vCPU and 2 GiB of memory.
STANDARD: 2 vCPUs and 4 GiB of memory.
HEAVY: 4 vCPUs and 8 GiB of memory
computeClass.description_zh: 计算规格。INTERACTIVE：1 vCPU、2 GiB 内存；STANDARD：2 vCPU、4 GiB 内存；HEAVY：4 vCPU、8 GiB 内存

hpa.description_en: The elastic policy configurations for the agent
hpa.description_zh: 智能体的弹性策略配置

enabled.description_en: Specifies whether elastic scaling is enabled. A value of true indicates that elastic scaling is enabled, and a value of false indicates that elastic scaling is disabled
enabled.description_zh: 是否启用弹性扩缩容。true 表示开启，false 表示关闭

maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.description_en: The maximum number of concurrent sessions configured for a single running instance
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.description_zh: 配置的单个运行实例最大并发会话数
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.title_en: 单 Sandbox 最大并发会话数
maxConcurrentSessionsPerSandbox.title_zh: 单 Sandbox 最大并发会话数

maxSandboxCount.description_en: The maximum number of running instances configured
maxSandboxCount.description_zh: 配置的最大运行实例数

minSandboxCount.description_en: The minimum number of running instances configured
minSandboxCount.description_zh: 配置的最小运行实例数

sessionTtlSeconds.description_en: The maximum idle time configured for a session, in seconds
sessionTtlSeconds.description_zh: 配置的会话空闲上限，单位为秒

sessionPolicy.description_en: The session policy configurations for the agent
sessionPolicy.description_zh: 智能体的会话策略配置

headerName.description_en: The name of the HTTP request header used by the session policy. This parameter is applicable to ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD
headerName.description_zh: 会话策略使用的 HTTP 请求头名称，适用于 ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD

type.description_en: The type of the session policy. Valid values: AFFINITY (session affinity), ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD (associates sessions by using the request header specified by headerName), and ISOLATED_COOKIE (not recommended). The compatible value DISABLED in requests is returned as AFFINITY
type.description_zh: 会话策略类型。AFFINITY：会话亲和；ISOLATED_HEADER_FIELD：使用 headerName 指定请求头关联会话。ISOLATED_COOKIE 暂不建议使用。请求中的兼容值 DISABLED 返回为 AFFINITY

additionalProperties.description_en: The number of instances in the corresponding running instance phase
additionalProperties.description_zh: 对应运行实例阶段的实例数量

sandboxPhaseCounts.description_en: The counts of running instances by phase. Keys include PENDING (creating or initializing), RUNNING (running), HIBERNATING (hibernating), HIBERNATED (hibernated), RESUMING (resuming), TERMINATING (terminating), and FAILED (failed). Only phases that actually occur are returned. Missing keys are treated as 0
sandboxPhaseCounts.description_zh: 按运行实例阶段统计数量。键包括 PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（终止中）和 FAILED（失败）。仅返回实际出现的阶段，缺少的键按 0 理解
sandboxPhaseCounts.title_en: 按 Sandbox Phase 统计自定义智能体的实例数量。当前 Key：PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（销毁中）、FAILED（运行时失败）。仅返回实际出现的 Phase，缺失 Key 按 0 处理。该字段为动态映射，后续可能新增 Key，前端可用 FAILED > 0 判断是否存在异常实例。
sandboxPhaseCounts.title_zh: 按 Sandbox Phase 统计自定义智能体的实例数量。当前 Key：PENDING（创建或初始化中）、RUNNING（运行中）、HIBERNATING（休眠中）、HIBERNATED（已休眠）、RESUMING（恢复中）、TERMINATING（销毁中）、FAILED（运行时失败）。仅返回实际出现的 Phase，缺失 Key 按 0 处理。该字段为动态映射，后续可能新增 Key，前端可用 FAILED > 0 判断是否存在异常实例。

status.description_en: The overall status of the agent. Valid values: Creating (creating), Running (running), Failed (failed), Updating (updating), Deleting (deleting), and Deleted (deleted). To check the execution progress of the latest configuration, query latestVersionStatus
status.description_zh: 智能体整体状态。Creating：创建中；Running：运行中；Failed：失败；Updating：更新中；Deleting：删除中；Deleted：已删除。最新配置执行进度请查询 latestVersionStatus

updatedAt.description_en: The time when the agent was last updated. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard. A trailing Z indicates the UTC time zone. Fractional seconds may be included
updatedAt.description_zh: 智能体最近更新时间，采用 ISO 8601 格式，末尾 Z 表示 UTC 时区，可包含小数秒

workspaceId.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom agent belongs
workspaceId.description_zh: 自定义智能体所属的工作空间 ID

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code of the request. A value of 200 indicates success
httpStatusCode.description_zh: 本次请求的 HTTP 状态码。成功时为 200

message.description_en: The processing result message of the request. The value is success if the request is successful
message.description_zh: 本次请求的处理结果说明。成功时为 success

requestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的唯一标识，用于定位和排查问题

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was processed successfully. A value of true indicates that the request was processed successfully. A successful creation, update, or deletion does not mean that the background operation is complete
success.description_zh: 请求是否处理成功。true 表示处理成功；创建、更新或删除成功不代表后台操作已经完成
